card.name: Prevent, preventive, prevention in titles
card.fires_on: The word Prevent, preventive or Prevention, often the ending of 'Preventive' or the capitalized word in a title or office name. It is strongest in names like American Journal of Preventive Medicine and Pollution Prevention.
